title: Backscatter Bicyclist
text: 来自骑行者的反向散射信号，输入 5 路、输出 4 路；按 {Azimuth angles (deg)} 指定方位角；{Number of wheel spokes} 指定每个车轮的辐条数、{Gear transmission ratio} 指定车轮转数与踏板转数之比、{Signal carrier frequency (Hz)} 指定载波频率 77e9、{Initial position (m)} 指定骑行者的初始位置、{Initial heading direction (deg)} 指定骑行者的初始航向、{Initial bicyclist speed (m/s)} 指定骑行者的初始速度、{Propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{RCS pattern} 指定 RCS 方向图来源、{Elevation angles (deg)} 指定俯仰角、{Radar cross section pattern (square meters)} 指定雷达截面积方向图 1-by-361 real-valued、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 入射雷达信号 complex-valued M -by- N matrix

ports.name: Ang
ports.summary: 入射信号的方向 real-valued 2-by- N vector

ports.name: Coast
ports.summary: 骑行者滑行状态 false (default) | true

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 合并后的反射雷达信号 complex-valued M -by-1 column vector

ports.name: Pos
ports.summary: 散射体的位置 real-valued 3-by- N matrix

ports.name: Vel
ports.summary: 散射体速度 real-valued 3-by- N matrix

params.name: Number of wheel spokes
params.values: 每个车轮的辐条数 20 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Gear transmission ratio
params.values: 车轮转数与踏板转数之比 1.5 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Initial position (m)
params.values: 骑行者的初始位置 [0;0;0] (default) | 3-by-1 real-valued vector

params.name: Initial heading direction (deg)
params.values: 骑行者的初始航向 0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Initial bicyclist speed (m/s)
params.values: 骑行者的初始速度 4 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Propagation speed (m/s)
params.values: 信号传播速度 physconst(’LightSpeed’) (default) | positive scalar

params.name: RCS pattern
params.values: RCS 方向图来源 Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Azimuth angles (deg)
params.values: 方位角 [-180:180] (default) | 1-by- P real-valued row vector | P -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: Elevation angles (deg)
params.values: 俯仰角 [-90:90] (default) | 1-by- Q real-valued row vector | Q -by-1 real-valued column vector

params.name: Radar cross section pattern (square meters)
params.values: 雷达截面积方向图 1-by-361 real-valued matrix (default) | Q -by- P real-valued matrix | 1-by- P real-valued vector

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 模块仿真方法 Interpreted Execution (default) | Code Generation
